title: A Computationally Efficient Multi-Section Whole Slide Image Analysis for Capturing Prostate Cancer Multifocality in Biochemical Recurrence Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2603.20273v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Prostate cancer is among the most frequently diagnosed malignancies in men worldwide. However, precise prediction of biochemical recurrence (BCR) after radical prostatectomy remains challenging. Here, we propose a computationally efficient multi section whole slide image analysis framework designed to capture the whole gland tumor landscape. We curated a large scale dataset comprising 23,451 slides from 789 patients and systematically optimized patch and slide sub sampling to substantially reduce the computational cost of training and inference. Under this efficient configuration, the framework achieved strong predictive performance for 1- and 2-year BCR, with discrimination and clinical net benefit comparable to or exceeding those of established clinical benchmarks. translated_title: 一种计算高效的多切片全切片图像分析方法，用于在生化复发预测中捕捉前列腺癌的多灶性
translated_abstract: 前列腺癌是全球男性中最常诊断的恶性肿瘤之一。然而，根治性前列腺切除术后生化复发（BCR）的精确预测仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出了一种计算高效的多切片全切片图像分析框架，旨在捕获整个腺体的肿瘤全景。我们构建了一个大规模数据集，包含来自789名患者的23,451张切片，并系统性地优化了图像块和切片的子采样策略，从而大幅降低了训练和推理的计算成本。在这种高效配置下，该框架对1年和2年生化复发实现了强劲的预测性能，其判别能力和临床净收益与现有临床基准相当甚至更优。在多变量Cox比例风险分析中，AI衍生的风险评分在所考察的协变量中仍然是独立的预后因素，并且其整合……
tldr: 该研究提出了一种计算高效的多切片全切片图像分析框架，通过优化子采样大幅降低计算成本，以捕获前列腺癌的多灶性特征，在生化复发预测中达到与临床基准相当或更优的性能，且AI风险评分是独立的预后因素。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a computationally efficient multi-section whole slide image analysis framework that captures prostate cancer multifocality, substantially reduces computational costs through optimized subsampling, achieves biochemical recurrence prediction performance comparable to or exceeding clinical benchmarks, and shows the AI-derived risk score is an independent prognostic factor.
